outOfScopeRows.rationale: ProjectX Studio ships curated, audited Cloudflare-native bricks, OpenAPI-imported packs, and generic HTTP/Webhook/Queue primitives rather than unverified third-party node wrappers
Control plane and assembled runtimes target Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1, R2, and Queues natively
Human + AI co-editing is coordinated through `BlueprintDO` monotonic revisions, SSE/WS live sync, and same-object conflict resolution cards
